headline: Arrive at the architecture review board ready, not revised
capabilities: Plan the design from the template, notes and brief in one step
Draft the vision, baseline and target design with inventory changes
Build the requirements matrix with owners, gaps and variances
Run a readiness check with a confidence score before each review
outcomes: Produced first drafts of design sections in hours instead of days
Arrived at review with owners named and variances answered
Reduced designs sent back for avoidable checklist gaps
why_try: The demo takes one fictional initiative from intake to a readiness verdict in six questions, with every gap traced to evidence.

sample_prompts.label: Solution Architect: Design intake and plan
sample_prompts.prompt: I have the design template, the discovery notes and the initiative brief for the delivery notifications project. Walk me through where to start.

sample_prompts.label: Solution Architect: Architecture vision draft
sample_prompts.prompt: Draft the vision: scope, stakeholders and which architecture domains are impacted.

sample_prompts.label: Solution Architect: Current-state baseline
sample_prompts.prompt: What does the current state look like for the systems in scope?

sample_prompts.label: Enterprise Architecture Lead: Non-functional requirements matrix
sample_prompts.prompt: Which non-functional requirements apply, and who owns each one?

sample_prompts.label: Solution Architect: Target design and inventory delta
sample_prompts.prompt: Draft the target design and list what changes in the inventory.

sample_prompts.label: Review Board Coordinator: Review-board readiness check
sample_prompts.prompt: Is this design ready for the review board?

business_flow: Approved design template and document library
Component inventory and requirement repository (read-only seams)
